paper.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking

result.summary: 本文提出 Quiet-STaR，将 STaR 从问答数据集推广到任意文本，让语言模型在每个 token 处生成内部理由（rationale）以解释后续文本，从而提升预测能力 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。方法包含并行理由生成、混合头（mixing head）以及基于 REINFORCE 的理由优化三个步骤 [S4.SS1.p1]。在 Mistral 7B 上使用 OpenWebMath 和 C4 继续预训练后，模型在无需下游任务微调的情况下，于 GSM8K 和 CommonsenseQA 上取得零样本提升 [S1.p3][S5.SS1.p1]。作者认为这朝着更通用、可扩展的推理学习迈出了一步 [S7.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：既然推理隐含在所有文本中，能否利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理，而不是依赖精心策划的问答数据集 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。作者指出，已有方法依赖特定推理任务或人工整理的数据集，限制了理由的规模和泛化性 [S1.p2]。因此，本文将 STaR 推广为从大规模互联网文本中学习生成有助于推断后续文本的理由 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We instead ask, if reasoning is implicit in all text, why shouldn’t we leverage the task of language modeling to teach reasoning?
Yet, training from curated QA datasets limits the scale and generalizability of the rationales.

Thus, we extend STaR – instead of the LM learning to reason on particular tasks like mathematical QA, we train an LM to generate reasoning that helps it infer future text from a large internet text corpus.

method.text: Quiet-STaR 包含三个主要步骤：并行理由生成（think）、混合理由后与基础预测（talk）、以及优化理由生成（learn）[S4.SS1.p1]。并行生成通过缓存前向传播并拼接对角注意力掩码，使所有 token 的理由可以并行生成 [S4.SS2.p3]。混合头是一个浅层 MLP，输出权重决定理由后的下一 token 预测 logits 与基础 LM 预测 logits 的混合程度 [S4.SS3.p1]。理由优化使用 REINFORCE，奖励为某条理由下未来 token 的对数概率与所有理由平均对数概率之差 [S4.SS4.SSS3.p1][S4.SS4.SSS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: Quiet-STaR operates with three main steps (Figure 1): 1. Parallel rationale generation (think, Subsection 4.2)
we cache each forward pass and concatenate a diagonal attention mask to the previous attention mask

Given the end-of-thought token’s hidden state and the hidden state of the original text token, the mixing head outputs a weight that determines the extent to which the post-thought prediction logits will be used.
We use REINFORCE to optimize the likelihoods of the rationales based on their usefullness
r_{j}=\log p_{j:j+n_{true}}^{\mathrm{talk}}(X_{j+1:j+n_{true}+1})-\log\overline{p}_{j:j+n_{true}}^{\mathrm{talk}}(X_{j+1:j+n_{true}+1})

experiments.text: 实验以 Mistral 7B 为基础模型 [S5.p1]。大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，该数据集被认为包含更高密度的需要推理的 token [S5.p2]。作者也在 C4 上评估，使用 16 个 thought token 和 4 个 true token ahead 的设置 [S5.SS1.p2]。评估任务为 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 的零样本直接推理能力 [S5.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
for our C4 evaluation, we train Mistral 7B with 16 thought tokens and 4 true tokens ahead and otherwise the same setup.
we evaluate the extent to which Quiet-STaR improves the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of the language model on CommonsenseQA and GSM8K.

findings.text: 在 OpenWebMath 上训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上比基础模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且提升随理由 token 数量增加而持续增大 [S5.SS1.p1]。在 C4 上训练也带来提升，但幅度较小：GSM8K 从 5.9% 到 8.1%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 到 42.6% [S5.SS1.p2]。与 pause token 微调相比，后者在 CommonsenseQA 上从 26.9% 到 28.8%，在 GSM8K 上损害性能，且额外 thought token 在多数任务上损害性能 [S5.SS1.p3]。在零样本链式思考中，8 样本多数投票准确率从 40.6% 提升到 47.7% [S5.SS3.p1]。作者还发现，思考对困难 token 的提升不成比例地更大 [S5.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
Similarly, on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model
training with Quiet-STaR on C4 also improves performance on GSM8K ( $5.9\%\rightarrow 8.1\%$) and CommonsenseQA ( $36.3\%\rightarrow 42.6\%$) but by a smaller margin.
they observed an improvement from 26.9% to 28.8%; on GSM8K, found that pause token fine-tuning harms performance.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR
there is a disproportionate improvement on more difficult tokens.

limitations.text: 作者承认，为解决问题而做了一些简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术是否适用于从零开始训练的模型，且只将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。Quiet-STaR 带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前需要生成许多 token [S6.p2]。当前实现不支持动态预测何时生成或结束理由 [S6.p2]。此外，作者指出无法知道模型用语言表达的推理是否准确反映其内部处理（忠实性），且没有防止有害或有偏推理模式的保障 [Sx1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it would be valuable to understand whether these techniques work when a model is trained from scratch.
We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model (i.e., faithfulness).
there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
